transcript.text: Ladies and Gentlemen, please welcome the USO and honoring WWE hometown hero, Staff Sergeant Millard Robert Stickler.
He serves in the Army National Guard right here in West Virginia as a human resources non-commission officer.
He's earned the Royal Danish Footmarks Medal along with an Air and Space Service Medal.
And congratulations, Staff Sergeant Millard Robert Stickler.
